findings.summary: a single commit that only quotes excerpts into a new file reaches C1_R57_PASS=true; freshness treats an absent-at-routing path as fresh
findings.fix: refuse keyed paths absent at routed_at; require item id in fixing commit message or keyed path named by the spot-check item

findings.summary: R56.7 keys have zero admissible BASE hits (spot-check and SOFT paths only); every control shows missing=1
findings.fix: freeze-time key admissibility check; re-key R56.7

findings.summary: fixed=/declined= count rows that fail their own checks (CTL_FAB: fixed=50, agree=12/51)
a search-based do-nothing agrees on 42/51 rows by citing unrelated later commits
skill arm is presence-only; a digits-only verdict map 0 ok; 2 ok; 3 ok passes
findings.fix: require exit-2/3 code names and PASS in the verdict-map cell

findings.summary: hard-wired rows kill only M3; a genuine drift row kills 3/3 (CTL_REF PASS)
first C2 run used an invalid registry source field; registry-check rc=2 correctly propagated; fixed
